# Swap
[Git Source](https://github.com/tenbinlabs/tenbin-contracts/blob/51cfcc3be55c1fc66666f437e8175c7820cc2918/src/external/bebop/IBebopHook.sol)

Bepop interface for a single swap leg between taker and maker


```solidity
struct Swap {
uint256 takerAmount;
address takerToken;
uint256 makerAmount;
address makerToken;
}
```
